pairs.why: A has a lighter glow behind the hero and a mid-key purple field like the real card's pale rings, while B's background is deeper and its hero shading is darker orange.
B's blue water darkens toward the edges, like the real card's deep blue field, while A's top is a brighter cyan; both have sand brighter and warmer than the real card's, so the difference is slight.
A has a lighter, softer split between the red wall and pale floor and no dark corner; B has a darker lower-left corner and a harder shadow. Both shadows are heavier than the real card's.
A's pink field is lighter with soft stripes and keeps the cream-and-green hero at mid-high key like the real card, while B's magenta is deeper and more saturated.
Both have a red-to-orange wall over a pale floor, a green hero and a heavy cast shadow; their value structure is about the same.
A's navy engine is a softer mid-dark mass in a bright scene, while B's near-black engine takes more area and gets darker than the real cards' small dark accents.
A has a bright glow behind the boot with slightly darker corners, like the real cards' light radial centre, while B's low-key brown boot sits on a flatter, duller orange.
B keeps the bright, high-key, saturated look of the real cards, with a mid-value orange hero against the green burst, while A's dark grey ground and big grey mass pull the key down.
